senses.gloss: m. pl. (disguise of Herculiani, cmp. דּוּרְמוֹס) Herculiani, a cohort of pretorians named after Diocletian (Heraclius).
units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:15">Esth. R. to I, 3</cite> <he>יכולני וכ׳</he> (read <he>יוֹבְיָינִי</he>); some ed. <he>בר קוריאני</he> (in two words) Joviani and Herculiani. v. Sachs Beitr. I, 113 sq., ref. to Amm. Marc. XXII, 3, 2.
